chunks: And what will make you comprehend what the Day of Judgement is?

key_terms.يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ: The Day of Judgement / The Day of Separation

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Yawm al-Fasl' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Yawm al-Fasl is understood not merely as a day of separation but as the definitive moment when the truth of divine authority (Wilayah) and the status of the Ahl al-Bayt are fully manifested to all creation. This rhetorical question underscores the gravity of the event, urging believers to prepare for the ultimate reckoning where every soul's deeds are weighed with precision.
